name: Pyrewood Ambush

narrative.details:
You got here just in the nick of time, adventurer!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment.  Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep.  He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control.  But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.

I cannot handle them all by myself.  I need you to help me.  Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.
narrative.objectives: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
narrative.offerRewardText: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, adventurer. With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. I salute you!
narrative.endText: Aid Faerleia in killing the Pyrewood Council
